I'm sorry your shoulder is tweaked. That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I'd get it looked at before we load it. Once they've cleared you, I'll train around whatever they tell you to avoid.

If you want the military press swapped out of your current program in the meantime, I can make that change for you. Just say the word and I'll set it up for you to confirm.
